answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The karst holds work receipts rather than names, so the dawn of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
